name: detect tiktok and bytedance hosts
spec_quote: tiktok: `lifeattiktok.com` / `api.lifeattiktok.com` → ident that host; ... bytedance: `joinbytedance.com` or `jobs.bytedance.com` → that host.

name: detect cornerstone site and ignore na.api.csod.com trap
spec_quote: cornerstone: `<slug>.csod.com`, keeping `/ux/ats/careersite/<digits>` when the URL has it ... A host that is only the end of a longer name (the `api.csod.com` inside `na.api.csod.com`) is not taken.

name: detect pageup mob and keka jobdetails
spec_quote: pageup: `careers.pageuppeople.com/<client digits>/<channel>/<locale>` → "client/channel/locale" (an optional leading "mob/" is kept). ... keka: `<tenant>.keka.com/careers[/<one segment>]` → "tenant.keka.com/careers[/segment]".

name: detect avature own-domain SearchJobs with locale and eightfold apply host
spec_quote: eightfold on the company's own domain: `apply.careers.<name>.<com|net|org|io>` → that host. ... avature on the company's own domain: a URL whose path is `/careers/SearchJobs` or `/careers/JobDetail` (optionally after one locale segment like `/en_US`) ... → "host" or "host/en_us".

name: detect ultipro.ca, moka, and darwinbox
spec_quote: moka `app.mokahr.com` / `hire-r1.mokahr.com` + `/social-recruitment/<slug>/<digits>` (or campus-) → that path with host; darwinbox `<slug>.darwinbox.in` / `.darwinbox.com` → host. ... ultipro: `recruiting<digits?>.ultipro.com` and now also `.ultipro.ca` boards.

name: clean tiktok lifeattiktok host
spec_quote: tiktok: "lifeattiktok.com", "api.lifeattiktok.com" or "tiktok" → "tiktok"

name: clean tiktok usds host
spec_quote: "careers.tiktokusds.com" or "usds" → "usds"

name: clean cornerstone with site
spec_quote: cornerstone: "<slug>.csod.com[/ux/ats/careersite/<n>[/…]]" → "<slug>.csod.com/<n>" (n = 1 when absent)

name: clean cornerstone without site
spec_quote: cornerstone: "<slug>.csod.com[/ux/ats/careersite/<n>[/…]]" → "<slug>.csod.com/<n>" (n = 1 when absent)

name: clean pageup with mob and tail
spec_quote: pageup: "[mob/]<digits>/<channel>/<xx or xx-yy>[/…]" → "<digits>/<channel>/<locale>" (mob/ and any tail dropped)

name: clean keka jobdetails is not a portal
spec_quote: keka: ... the segments api, applyjob, jobdetails, content are not portals (→ just the host)

name: clean vendor personio slug
spec_quote: personio / softgarden / gupy / beisen: exactly "<slug>.jobs.personio.com|de" ... a vendor slug (www, api, app, login, portal …) → null.

name: clean gem vendor api slug
spec_quote: gem / recruiterbox / join / hrmos / herp: a slug of letters, digits, '_', '.', '-' starting with a letter or digit → unchanged; vendor words (www, api, app, jsapi, v1, pages …) → null.

name: clean avature custom host with locale
spec_quote: eightfold / avature on a non-vendor host (custom_host): a host with at least three labels that is not the bare company domain ... → the host; for avature a first path segment that is a locale ("en_us", "en-us", "en", "global", "us") is kept, a 5-character one written as "en_US"; any other path dropped.

name: clean eightfold bare company domain
spec_quote: eightfold / avature on a non-vendor host (custom_host): a host with at least three labels that is not the bare company domain ("acme.com", "www.acme.com") → the host

name: page systems eightfold custom host
spec_quote: an Eightfold page — it contains "window._EF_GROUP_ID =" or "_EF_PRODUCT" AND the word "eightfold" (any case) → ["eightfold", custom_host of the url host]

name: page systems avature locale
spec_quote: an Avature page — the url path is /careers/SearchJobs… or /careers/JobDetail… (optionally after one locale segment) AND the page contains "avature" (any case) → ["avature", custom_host of host + locale]

name: page systems rejects www avature host
spec_quote: Hosts custom_host rejects give nothing.

name: big tech TikTok
spec_quote: "TikTok" (optionally + Inc / Inc. / Shop / US / USA, nothing else) → [["tiktok", "tiktok"]]

name: big tech TikTok USDS
spec_quote: a name starting "TikTok" that contains "USDS" or "U.S. Data Security" → [["tiktok", "usds"]]

name: big tech ByteDance Inc
spec_quote: "ByteDance" (optionally + Inc / Ltd) → [["bytedance", "bytedance"]]

name: throne location walks city_info parents
expect: San Jose, California, United States of America
spec_quote: throne_location(item): walk item.city_info → .parent → … collecting en_name (else name): "San Jose, California, United States of America"

name: parse throne tiktok posting
spec_quote: parse_throne(d, tenant): d.data.job_post_list[] with id and title (else name). url = "https://lifeattiktok.com/search/<id>" (tiktok), ...

name: csod session context token and api
spec_quote: csod_session(page) → [token, api]: token from `csod.context.token = '…'` (or "…"), else from a `"token":"…"` field; api = the first "https://<x>.api.csod.com" in the page, else "https://na.api.csod.com"

name: csod session json token default api
spec_quote: token from `csod.context.token = '…'` (or "…"), else from a `"token":"…"` field; api = the first "https://<x>.api.csod.com" in the page, else "https://na.api.csod.com"

name: parse csod first location only
spec_quote: parse_csod(d, host, site, slug): d.data.requisitions[] with requisitionId and displayJobTitle; location = the FIRST entry of locations: its city, state, country (string fields that are present) joined ", "; url = "https://<host>/ux/ats/careersite/<site>/job/<requisitionId>?c=<slug>"

name: parse gem with extId and id fallback
spec_quote: parse_gem(d, slug): d is a list; d[0].data.oatsExternalJobPostings.jobPostings[] with title and extId (else id); url = "https://jobs.gem.com/<slug>/<extId>"; location = each location's name (else city; "Remote" when isRemote and no name) joined "; "

name: parse pageup joined url and location
spec_quote: parse_pageup(page, base): each `Title`; location = the next `class="location"` element's text before the following job link; url = href joined to base; each job id once.

name: parse personio office and offices
spec_quote: parse_personio(d, host): d is a list of {id, name, office, offices}; url = "https://<host>/job/<id>"; location = office, else offices joined "; ".

name: parse recruiterbox location and remote fallback
spec_quote: parse_recruiterbox(d): d.objects[] with title and hosted_url starting "https://"; location = location.city, .state, .country (non-empty) joined ", "; when all empty and allows_remote is true → "Remote".

name: schema location dedupes places
expect: Austin, TX, US; Dallas, TX, US
spec_quote: schema_location(loc): ... per place address.addressLocality, addressRegion, addressCountry (non-empty strings) joined ", "; places joined "; ", duplicates once.

name: parse softgarden jobLocation
spec_quote: parse_softgarden(d): d.dataFeedElement[].item with title and url starting "https://"; location = schema_location(item.jobLocation).

name: join company id from nested id
spec_quote: join_company_id(page): the digits in `"company":{"id":N` (else `"companyId":N`, quotes around N allowed) → string; else null.

name: parse join url fallback and city location
spec_quote: parse_join(d, slug): d.items[] with id and title; url = item.url, else "https://join.com/companies/<slug>/jobs/<idParam or id>"; location = city.cityName, city.regionName, city.countryName joined ", ".

name: keka identifier lowercases guid
spec_quote: keka_identifier(page): the GUID in "/ats/documents/<guid>/careerportal/" or "/careers/api/embedjobs/js/<guid>", lower-cased; else null.

name: parse keka multiple locations

expect.title: Engineer
expect.location: Austin, TX, US; Dallas, TX, US

spec_quote: parse_keka(d, host): d is a list of {id, title, jobLocations[{city, state, countryName}]}; url = "https://<host>/careers/jobdetails/<id>"; location = per entry city, state, countryName joined ", ", entries joined "; ".

name: parse gupy next data
spec_quote: parse_gupy(page, host): the JSON in `<script id="__NEXT_DATA__" …>…</script>` → props.pageProps.jobs[] with id and title; url = "https://<host>/jobs/<id>"; location = workplace.address city, stateShortName (else state), country joined ", ". Bad JSON → [].

name: parse hrmos card
spec_quote: parse_hrmos(page): each `<li class="pg-list-cassette …">` card: link "https://hrmos.co/pages/<x>/jobs/<id>", title = its <h2> text, location = its `class="sg-tag-location"` <li> text (else "").

name: parse herp ignores other slug
spec_quote:
parse_herp(page, slug): each `

Title

`; url = "https://herp.careers/v1//"; location ""; each link once; links of another slug ignored.

name: beisen portal id
spec_quote: beisen_portal(page): the object after `var BSGlobal =` parsed as JSON → its PortalId as a string; missing / bad JSON → null.
